home.hero_title: Reliable IT infrastructure and custom software, engineered for outcomes.
home.meta_title: Deploris Managed IT and Custom Software Development
home.meta_description: Managed IT infrastructure, custom CRM, RAG systems, and AI agents under written SLAs. One team for US and German businesses.
home.hero_body: Deploris delivers hands-on hardware and infrastructure services alongside custom CRM, RAG systems, AI agents, and bespoke software one team, one point of accountability, from wiring closet to production release.
home.trust_bar: Trusted for enterprise IT and custom AI systems
home.split_hardware_body: Rollouts, migrations, break-fix, WiFi surveys, and 24/7 data-center support. Predictable SLAs, on-site or remote.
home.split_dev_body: Custom CRMs, retrieval-augmented AI, agentic automation, and bespoke systems production-grade, security-reviewed, delivered on schedule.
home.value_1_b: Rare in the market: senior hardware operators and senior engineers under one roof, sharing context and accountability.
home.value_2_b: Hardened headers, hardened code, EU-region processing, and audited email + form flows on every project.
home.value_3_b: We define success up front uptime, response time, adoption, revenue lift and report against it every sprint.
home.value_4_b: German and English, formal Sie for German B2B, and documentation your teams can actually operate from.
home.cta_bottom_b: Send us your requirements. You'll get a written scope, timeline, and price band within one business day no sales dance.
